notes: Shelves are looking bare, dear. {item}, if you can spare it.
A customer asked for {item}. I said 'my farmer has some'. Don't make a liar of me!
{item}, please. I'll put the kettle on when you bring it.
Running low on {item}. Tobias never let me run low. No pressure. Some pressure.
Could you bring me some {item}? I've got a pie in mind.
{item}! The store isn't the store without {item}.
Crew's hungry. {item}. Measure twice, harvest once.
Need {item} for the lads. They work better fed.
{item}, if you've got it. Good posts need good lunches.
My father swore by {item}. He also swore at most things.
Bring {item} by the yard. I'll be the one covered in sawdust.
{item}. That's it. That's the note. Carpenters keep it short.
{item}. Don't make a thing of it.
Hmph. {item}. Please. There, I said it.
Need {item}. Not for me. For... a friend. Fine, it's for me.
{item}, if you're passing. You're always passing.
Edie liked {item}. That's all. Bring some.
The mill could use {item}. The miller too.
Sorry! Could I have some {item}? Sorry. Thank you. Sorry.
I'm trying a {item} recipe. Only a little bit of it will burn!
{item}, please! The ovens are warm and my nerves are warmer.
If I had {item}, I could make something wonderful. Probably. Maybe.
Could you spare {item}? I'll save you the first un-burnt one.
{item}! I need it for a surprise. The surprise is I need {item}.
A buyer in the next valley wants {item}. Leaving soon!
{item}! I'll trade it for a story. And coins. Mostly coins.
My cart has a {item}-shaped gap. Leaving soon!
Fine {item} sells like magic out east. Help a merchant out?
{item}, friend! For a very important customer. It's me.
Quick, before the road calls: {item}!
I require {item} for a study. Mostly a study. Partly lunch.
Specimen request: {item}. Please label it. I'll label it again anyway.
{item}, please. For science. And for the jam stains.
I'm comparing {item} across three farms. Yours is the only farm.
Could you bring {item}? My notes have a gap and I can't stand gaps.
{item}. Healthy, ripe, unbruised. You know the drill.
Moss says {item}. I think he means {item}. He might mean hi.
{item} for the workshop! Don't ask what for. I don't know yet.
Need {item}! The new gadget runs on it. In theory.
Moss would like {item}. Moss would like everything.
Could you bring {item}? I promise nothing will explode. Much.
{item}, please! Moss has already written you a thank-you. It's a paw print.
{item}. The creek's in a mood and so am I.
Could use {item} on the boat. Mind the third plank on the way.
{item}, please. I'll ferry you across for free. I always do.
The fish have been asking about {item}. Don't ask me how.
Bring {item} down to the dock when you're passing.
{item}. Slow and steady, like the river. No rush.
A letter from Tobias, from across the creek.

specials.title: The 1987 Pie, Again
specials.note: I'm baking Tobias another pie. Interest, you understand. Thirty-odd years of it.

keepsake.name: Goldie's pie tin
keepsake.text: Dented, polished, and engraved 'IOU'. She says the debt is settled. Tobias disagrees.

specials.title: Market Day Stock-Up
specials.note: The whole valley's coming to the market. I want every shelf groaning.

keepsake.name: The store bell
keepsake.text: The brass bell from over Goldie's door. 'It rings when someone I like comes in. So, always.'

specials.title: The Crew's Big Lunch
specials.note: Six men, one roof, no lunch. That's a problem with a simple fix.

keepsake.name: Bruno's pencil stub
keepsake.text: Chewed at one end, sharp at the other. Measure twice.

specials.title: A Picnic on the Bench
specials.note: I built a bench. A bench needs a picnic, or what's it for?

keepsake.name: A tiny town sign
keepsake.text: A carved copy of the Bramblewick sign. The second B is backwards. On purpose, he says.

specials.title: Grain Cart Rematch
specials.note: Old Pell down the valley wants a rematch. Fill the cart. Heavy. I'm not losing twice.

keepsake.name: Racing ribbon (1979)
keepsake.text: Second place. 'The other fellow cheated.' He didn't.

specials.title: Edie's Sunday Bake
specials.note: Edie baked on Sundays. I've found her recipe. Don't make a thing of it.

keepsake.name: Edie's recipe card
keepsake.text: Flour-thumbed and folded twice. Rufus copied it out for you in his best handwriting.

specials.title: The Un-Burnt Batch
specials.note: I'm going to bake a whole batch without burning any. Sorry in advance if I don't!

keepsake.name: Pip's oven mitt
keepsake.text: Scorched on one thumb. 'It's lucky now. Sorry.'

specials.title: Festival Tarts
specials.note: Harvest festival tarts! For everyone! I've never baked for everyone. Help?

keepsake.name: Festival tart tin
keepsake.text: Fluted, slightly bent, and still smelling of pumpkin.

specials.title: The Deal of a Lifetime
specials.note: A duke! A real duke wants Bramblewick goods. Probably a duke. A man in a hat.

keepsake.name: Half a treasure map
keepsake.text: To somewhere. Ziggy swears the other half is 'around'.

specials.title: Cart Repairs
specials.note: The cart lost a wheel. And a cousin. Just the wheel, actually. Help me pay for it?

specials.title: The Specimen Survey
specials.note: A full survey of your crops. For the journal. I'm not excited. I'm thorough.

keepsake.name: A pressed sunflower
keepsake.text: Labelled in tiny letters: Helianthus annuus. Your farm. A good year.

specials.title: Field Station Supplies
specials.note: I'm camping by the creek for a week. Notes, snacks, and a crayfish census.

keepsake.name: Hazel's hand lens
keepsake.text: Brass, scratched, perfect. 'Look closer. Always look closer.'

specials.title: Moss's Birthday Feast
specials.note: It's Moss's birthday! Again! He has a lot of them. He wants cake. And carrots. And cake.

keepsake.name: Moss's chewed ball
keepsake.text: Very loved. Slightly damp. Moss wants you to have it, then wants it right back.

specials.title: Prototype Fuel
specials.note: The new machine runs on corn, strawberries and fish. Don't look at me like that.

keepsake.name: Juniper's spare cog
keepsake.text: It doesn't fit anything. 'Yet,' she says.

specials.title: Bait and Breakfast
specials.note: Early start on the river. Breakfast for me, breakfast for the fish.

keepsake.name: Nell's red float
keepsake.text: Forty years old. 'Still floats. Like me.'

specials.title: Mending the Flood Marks
specials.note: The old flood post needs a new coat and a new rope. The creek remembers. So do I.

keepsake.name: A river stone with a hole
keepsake.text: Look through it at the creek. Nell says you'll see it as it was.

specials.title: From the Old Seed Shed
specials.note: Found my old seed shed, still standing. Barely. Send a few things across and I'll set it right.

keepsake.name: Tobias's seed packet
keepsake.text: Hand-labelled in faded ink: 'Ruby Heart. Not yet.'

specials.title: A Letter, and a List
specials.note: Writing a list keeps an old man young. Filling one keeps him fed.

keepsake.name: Tobias's pocket watch
keepsake.text: Runs four minutes slow, 'so I'm never early for anything I'd rather miss.'
